summary.text: One of the fifty-seven suitors from Dulichium in Apollodorus' island catalogue — attested only in the named roll that follows Epitome 7.26.

story.text: Apollodorus names Bias among the wooers who came from Dulichium, listed after Damastor and before Telmius in the catalogue of those who devoured Odysseus' house. Not to be confused with Bias the Aeolid seer's brother at Pylos (Bibliotheca 1.9.11–13).
